input: Unmodified 2.4 MS/s unsigned 8-bit IQ via stdin; no native USB driver.
androidChanges: readsb.h: use posix_memalign for API 26 compatibility
util.c: Android uses a mutex-protected condition wake followed by POSIX pthread_join, preserving upstream wake-before-join behavior without pthread_tryjoin_np
readsb.c: publish final aircraft.json for Android ifile shutdown after worker joins, using the existing JSON encoder
readsb.c: reader shutdown respects an already requested exitSoon, avoiding an EOF normal-exit/abnormal-exit race
sdr_ifile.c: Android stdin pipe uses bounded POSIX poll to observe shutdown while input is idle
readsb.c: Android signal handlers are installed after configuration defaults and exit event descriptors are initialized
readsb.c: Android exit signal handler only requests exit; timestamp logging stays on normal threads to avoid libc time-lock re-entry
No changes to demod_2400.c, mode_s.c, crc.c, cpr.c or track.c
